name: Dancenter Promenade Near Cihampelas Walk
detail: The location is very strategic, close to various attractions, with complete facilities including comfortable parking and hot water always available. The rooms are spacious and clean, and the friendly and responsive staff make the stay even more enjoyable. The prices offered are very reasonable given the quality received.

name: Townhouse Oak Casa D'Ladera Bandung
detail: The room is spacious and comfortable. Staying here for 5 nights was quite enjoyable because it is quiet, close to UPI campus, near Lembang, and there are many places to eat. There is a gym available. They provided 2 towels, 2 small bottles of mineral water, and 1 bottle of body wash, and the water heater works well. The AC is very cold. The cable TV works well. There is a small fridge, but unfortunately, the fridge in my room was broken. Perhaps more attention should be given to the bed linens and towels as their colors have become dull and dirty. The cleanliness of the bathroom is lacking because there were still some hair leftovers. The staff is friendly. There is ample parking. I recommend staying here.

name: Collection O Hotel Pasar Baru Heritage
detail: So nice, really the best. I'm exhausted after a long trip, saw the bed and just collapsed because the room is cool, fragrant, and clean.

name: Holiday Inn Express Bandung Braga by IHG
detail: Staying at the Holiday Inn Express Bandung Braga provides a quite pleasant experience, especially for those looking for a modern hotel with a strategic location in the center of Bandung. The first impression upon entering the hotel is very good as the condition of the hotel is still new, clean, and well-maintained. The lobby area to the rooms looks tidy with the modern vibe typical of Holiday Inn Express that is simple yet comfortable. The cleanliness of the room is also one of the plus points during the stay. The room size does feel a bit compact, especially if you bring a lot of belongings or stay with family. However, this drawback is offset by the comfort of the bed and the functional room facilities. Additionally, the hotel’s location is a major selling point as it is very close to the iconic Braga area and various viral spots in Bandung. Many cafes, dining places, and photo spots can be reached just by walking, making it very practical for sightseeing without the need to frequently use transportation. The breakfast facilities included in the room rate also add value. The breakfast menu options are quite varied, making it easy to start the morning activities before exploring Bandung. For a practical hotel class like Holiday Inn Express, the quality of the breakfast is already satisfactory and makes the stay feel more worthwhile. Another helpful aspect is the complimentary valet parking service. This is very convenient, especially since the Braga area is quite crowded and parking can sometimes be troublesome. With the valet and parking at no additional cost, the stay feels more comfortable and practical.

name: Aryaduta Bandung
detail: A hotel where you can stay cheaply and comfortably for work. A tavern right in front. The breakfast is delicious. The hotel has a well-equipped gym and garden. Shopping is convenient with direct access to BIP from the hotel. It's cheap for a five-star hotel. On the other hand, the desk lamp is dim, making it difficult to work at night. The shower is fixed, but it's nice to have a bathtub. Despite these drawbacks, the satisfaction level is high.

name: Kimaya Braga Bandung by Harris
detail: Lokasi sangat strategis, recomended, untuk yang ingin menghabiskan waktu di Bandung khususnya di Area jalan Braga, deket banget tinggal jalan kaki, sebrangnya filosofi coffe, kamarnya bersih, nyaman, untuk bertiga dengan anak juga masih nyaman, dapet bantal 3 dan guling juga, surprise banget, dan banyak spot2 untuk bisa nyimpan barang2 jadi ga berantakan paling the best sih lokasinya... pokoknya Recommended, kalau mau ke Bandung lagi mau nginep di Kimaya lagi

name: Best Western Premier La Grande Hotel
detail: For those coming from outside the city and wanting to explore Bandung, this hotel is a great choice. It's close to everything, surrounded by great dining options, malls, and easily accessible via ride-hailing apps/taxis. I stayed in a superior room, which was quite spacious, clean, had many large windows, and on the upper floor, you can get a view of the mountains. The heated swimming pool allows you to enjoy swimming even though the weather is cold. All the hotel staff are friendly and helpful. If I may suggest...what could be improved is the taste of the breakfast dishes. The menu is quite varied, but the flavor of the food is lacking. I had breakfast there twice, so I played it safe and chose bread, fruit, and eggs. I tried the cooked dishes, and the taste was not good. Maybe next time when I come back it will be better. Thank you...

name: Grand Dafam Braga Bandung
detail: Honestly, everything about our stay here was perfect! ❤️ The cleanliness was top-notch — the room was very clean, spacious and comfortable. The location was also excellent, especially because it’s very close to Jalan Braga, which is such a happening area at night. Easy to walk around, explore and enjoy the atmosphere. The staff were absolutely amazing! Everyone was so friendly, helpful and welcoming, and a big plus point for us was that they could communicate fluently in Malay, which made everything so much easier and comfortable. The breakfast was also really good — lots of choices and everything tasted delicious. The breakfast staff were especially attentive. They even offered us sejadah, extra towels and pillows without us having to ask. Such a small gesture, but it really made us feel well taken care of. Overall, we had such a pleasant and comfortable stay. Clean room, spacious space, great location, delicious food and excellent hospitality. Definitely a hotel I would happily recommend and come back to again!

name: Crowne Plaza Bandung By IHG
detail: The room is spacious and clean. The bathroom is also large and comfortable, with a bathtub. The room's AC is very cold, and even after turning it off, the room remains quite cool. The breakfast is quite tasty and varied, with an Indomie stall and ice cream. There is a playground for children.

name: THE 1O1 Bandung Dago Hotel
detail: This place offers rooms with a comfortable size and adequate hot water facilities, ideal for resting. Its location is very strategic, close to shopping centers, making access easy. Cleanliness is well maintained, but staff service could be improved for a more enjoyable experience. Overall, the value received is very comparable to the price paid.
